mg.pour.hint: Feed the flame without drowning it. Keep it inside the golden band.
mg.pour.controls: Mouse up and down, W/S or ↑/↓: tilt the amphora
mg.pour.tut1: Tilt the amphora: move the mouse up, or hold W or ↑.
mg.pour.tut2: The oil feeds the flame. Keep the tip of the flame inside the golden band, between the two lines.
mg.pour.tut3: Too little oil and it shrinks; too much and it chokes. The wind will get in the way. Space to begin.
mg.reveal.hint: Pass the flame over what is hidden.
mg.reveal.controls: Mouse, WASD or arrows: move the flame · Space: lower the cup
mg.reveal.tut1: Move the flame with the mouse, WASD or the arrows.
mg.reveal.tut2: When the light trembles, something is hidden nearby. Stop over it and hold until the ring closes.
mg.reveal.tut3: Every use of the Flame of Truth has its price: see the cracks at the edges. Space lowers the cup whenever you want. Space to continue.
mg.descent.controls: W/↑ or click: step down · S/↓ or right click: step back
mg.descent.tut1: W, ↑ or click: go down one step. Go down two.
mg.descent.tut2: S, ↓ or right click: go back up one step. At the top of the stairs, going back means leaving.
mg.descent.tut3: Down there, you will decide with your hands, not with words. Space to continue.
mg.descent.encounterControls: W/↑ or click: raise the cup · S/↓: back away · or stay still
mg.embers.hint: Save the embers before they die.
mg.embers.controls: Mouse or WASD: move the hand · click or Space: take the ember
mg.embers.tut1: Move the hand with the mouse or WASD.
mg.embers.tut2: Click or press Space over an ember to take it. It goes to the middle of the bowl. It will hurt.
mg.embers.tut3: The flame is only reborn when every ember is in the middle. There is no hurry: only pain. Space to begin.
mg.rhythm.hint: Sing in time with the flame.
mg.rhythm.controls: Space, click or W/↑ when the ring touches the golden circle
mg.rhythm.tut1: A ring of light closes over the flame. Press Space (or click) the moment it touches the golden circle. Hit it twice.
mg.rhythm.tut2: Like that. Now the real chant, in front of everyone. Enter to begin.
mg.trace.hint: Follow the groove with your finger.
mg.trace.controls: Hold the left mouse button and drag: the finger follows, pressed to the stone
mg.trace.tut1: Hold the left mouse button and bring the finger to the glint, where the letter begins.
mg.trace.tut2: Now follow the groove to its end, without leaving it.
mg.trace.tut3: Every letter is a path. The stone remembers who touches it. Space to begin.
mg.restraint.hint: Breathe. Don't let the beast out.
mg.restraint.controls: Hold Space (or the mouse button) while the ring grows; release while it shrinks
mg.restraint.tut1: The ring grows: hold Space (or the mouse button). Breathe in.
mg.restraint.tut2: The ring shrinks: let go. Let the air out.
mg.restraint.tut3: The beast will pull, harder and harder. Breathe with the ring. Enter to begin.

mg.threads.hint: The threads that hold this person.
mg.threads.controls: Drag across a thread: cut · Rest the mouse on a thread: loosen · Press on one thread and release on another: tie · Space: leave
mg.threads.tut1: Move the mouse over a thread to see what it ties the person to.
mg.threads.tut2: To cut, drag across the thread. To loosen, rest the mouse on it. To tie, press on one thread and release on another. Space leaves everything as it is. Space to continue.
mg.shells.hint: Palm the pebble while the mark isn't looking.
mg.shells.controls: Hold the mouse button or Space: palm the pebble
mg.shells.tut1: The mark’s face is at the top right. Wait for the eye to close: DISTRACTED is your chance.
mg.shells.tut2: Now hold the mouse button or Space until the ring around the cup fills.
mg.shells.tut3: When the eye starts to open (ABOUT TO LOOK), let go: if the mark looks while you hold, they see. Twice and you are caught. Click or Space to continue.
mg.shells.belt.controls: Hold the mouse button or Space: undo one turn of the knot
mg.shells.belt.tut1: Her face is at the top right. Wait for the eye to close: she is looking at the sea.
mg.shells.belt.tut2: Now hold the mouse button or Space until the ring around the knot fills.
mg.shells.belt.tut3: When the eye starts to open (ABOUT TO LOOK), let go: if she looks while you hold, she sees. Twice and you are caught. Click or Space to continue.
